selected_layouts.source_locator: TA-8, Figure 6P-8, Road Closure with an Off-Site Detour, PDF pages 914–915 / printed pages 874–875; TA-8 paragraph 01
matched_scene_facts: The opposing-direction lane is explicitly confirmed fully closed.
Opposing traffic is prohibited from entering the closed route and detours via other roads.
The work zone is adjacent to an intersection.
Channelizing devices define the closed-route boundary and taper.
The work duration is less than three days.
The roadway is an urban two-way street with the ego-direction path remaining open.
conflicting_scene_facts: TA-8 depicts road-closure and off-site-detour controls, while the observed closure is direction-specific: the opposing lane is closed and the ego-direction lane remains open. This requires interpreting the TA-8 closure treatment for the affected direction rather than treating the entire cross-section as closed.

requirements.threshold: the work space or any detour

activation_basis.explanation: The scoped closure/restriction activates advance warning; the check is limited to the observable approach.

requirements.source_span: The ROAD (STREET) WORK (W20-1) sign (see Figure 6H-1), which serves as a general warning of obstructions or restrictions, should be located in advance of the work space or any detour, on the road where the work is taking place.

requirements.candidate_label: Tangent channelizer spacing does not exceed 2 times posted speed
requirements.subject: tangent channelizing devices
requirements.relation: are spaced no farther apart than
requirements.threshold: 2 times the posted speed in mph, expressed in feet; at 20 mph, 40 ft maximum
applicability_conditions: Channelizing devices are used along a tangent section of the TTC zone.

measurement_spec.quantity: maximum longitudinal spacing between consecutive tangent channelizing devices

activation_basis.explanation: The scene confirms a closed opposing lane bounded by a longitudinal line of channelizers; tangent spacing is independently field-auditable.

requirements.source_span: The spacing between cones, tubular markers, vertical panels, drums, and barricades should not exceed a distance in feet equal to 1 times the speed limit in mph when used for taper channelization, and should not exceed a distance in feet equal to 2 times the speed limit in mph when used for tangent channelization.

requirements.threshold: no inapplicable WRONG WAY signs, markings, or other existing traffic-control devices remain exposed within the directional closure
applicability_conditions: The opposing directional roadway is closed, as explicitly confirmed for this scene.

required_inputs: visible existing signs and markings at the intersection within the closure

activation_basis.explanation: The user-confirmed directional closure and the visible intersection activate this field-observable check for inapplicable intersection controls.

requirements.source_span: When a directional roadway is closed, inapplicable WRONG WAY signs and markings, and other existing traffic control devices at intersections within the temporary two-lane, two-way operations section shall be covered, removed, or obliterated.
